R. K. Dalmia: 
Thank you, Karan. I'm R.K. Dalmia. A very good evening to you all. India's economy maintained 
strong momentum in 2QFY27, supported by resilient domestic demand and investment activity. 
1QFY27 GDP growth stood at 7.8%, ahead of the RBI's earlier estimate with healthy PMI 
readings and GST collections. Reflecting this resilience, the RBI revised its FY27 GDP growth 
forecast upward to 7.1%.  
The external environment continued to face headwinds from geopolitical tensions, elevated 
energy prices and tighter financial conditions. Headline CPI inflation rose from 4.45% in July 
to 5.4% in September. Nevertheless, the domestic growth demand remains supportive of the real 
estate sector.  
MMR remained the largest residential market with sales of approximately INR59,500 crores, up 
11% Y-o-Y. Pune and Bengaluru also maintained healthy momentum and with absorption 
growing 3% Y-o-Y and prices increasing 3% in Pune and 8% in Bengaluru. Together, MMR, 
Bengaluru, Pune and NCR accounted for around 65% of Pan-India sales by value.  
The commercial office segment remained strong in 2QFY27, reaching approximately 21 million 
square feet, up 6% Y-o-Y, taking 9 months leasing to a record 66.4 million square feet. GCCs 
remained the key demand driver, accounting for around 41% of leasing, alongside robust 
demand for Grade A and green-certified assets.  
Against this backdrop, we delivered a strong 1HFY27 performance. Total income increased 
309% Y-o-Y to INR355 crores including INR268 crores in Q2, up 755% Y-o-Y. Collections 
increased 39% Y-o-Y to INR1,465 crores in 1HFY27. This Q2 collection was  INR752 crores, 
up 47% Y-o-Y. We also crossed the landmark milestone of INR10,000 crores in cumulative 
collection across our projects.  
In terms of profitability, Birla Tisya recognized EBITDA of INR181 crores at 28% EBITDA 
margin, while Birla Navya contributed INR39 crores at 35% EBITDA margin. Our financial 
position also strengthened with CARE improving BEPL's credit outlook from AA stable to AA

positive. 2QFY27 booking value stood at INR298 crores, with Birla Taranya and Birla Niyaara 
in MMR being the largest contributors, supported by sustenance sales across our key markets.  
On business development, in October '26, we announced a JDA for 5.6 acres prime residential 
land parcel in Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune. The project has a GDV potential of approximately 
INR1,650 crores, further strengthening our Pune portfolio and future development pipeline. At 
our flagship Worli development, we have chosen to redesign Tower C to unlock its full potential.

accretive to profitability, while the resultant deferment of the launch to the next financial year 
may impact current presales. This reflects our disciplined focus on long-term shareholder value 
over near-term launch timelines.

additional opportunities across high demand MMR micro markets- this remains an important 
avenue of growth supported by trusted partnerships and disciplined capital allocation.  ESG 
remains integral to our operations. In the 2026 GRESB assessment, Birla scored 95.9 out of 100 
and received a 5-star rating for standing investments and 100 out of 100 for development. We 
were recognized as a global sector leader in both benchmarks and ranked first in Asia for 
management score. Looking ahead, we remain focused on disciplined growth and consistent 
execution supported by a strong balance sheet and a robust opportunity pipeline.  
Our priorities are to expand selectively across key markets, deliver high-quality development, 
strengthen our portfolio through business development and redevelopment and create 
sustainable long-term value for all stakeholders. Thank you. We will now open the floor for 
Q&A.
